description: A standard scan must return a single valid JSON object carrying at least 3 cards and echoing the requested horizon.

expected_output.shape: single JSON object with keys topic, horizon_days, summary, cards

rubric.condition: The entire output parses as a single JSON object with json.loads and no surrounding prose or markdown fences.
The cards array contains at least 3 items.
The cards array contains at most 8 items.
The summary field contains the literal digits of the requested horizon_days value, which is 30.

notes: Anchored to prompt.md's Card count and shape / Summary rules.
